slides.headline: 6 APPS YOU'RE PAYING FOR THAT ARE ALREADY FREE
slides.image_prompt: Two hands cutting through six app-interface cards with scissors, one marked with FREE symbol; gold coins spraying from cut, wrists-only framing, deep indigo background, electric orange underlighting; documentary news photo, 35mm film grain.

slides.headline: 1) EDIT ANY PHOTO LIKE PHOTOSHOP FOR FREE
slides.body: People pay $250 a year for Photoshop. Photopea does the same thing in a browser tab: layers, RAW files, masks, and PSD exports, with no account. Go to photopea.com. Open any image file.

slides.headline: 2) FORMAT AND FIX ANY CODE FOR FREE
slides.body: IT-Tools is a free site with over 60 developer utilities in one browser page: JSON formatters, UUID generators, Base64 encoders, and regex testers. Go to it-tools.tech. Search for any tool and use it.

slides.headline: 3) DITCH YOUR $150 WHITEBOARD APP
slides.body: Miro and Mural charge up to $150 a year. Excalidraw runs in your browser with no account and generates a link your whole team opens instantly without signing up. Go to excalidraw.com. Start drawing.

slides.headline: 4) CHECK IF YOUR EMAIL WAS STOLEN IN A BREACH
slides.body: Over 13 billion accounts have been exposed in data breaches. Have I Been Pwned checks your email against every known leak and names which breach it was in. Go to haveibeenpwned.com. Type your email.

slides.headline: 5) RUN AI TOOLS FOR FREE WITHOUT AN ACCOUNT
slides.body: Hugging Face Spaces hosts thousands of AI tools that run in a browser tab: image generators, background removers, voice tools, and text editors. Most need zero sign-up. Go to huggingface.co/spaces. Search any AI task.

slides.headline: 6) TAKE MIT COURSES FOR NOTHING
slides.body: MIT puts every lecture, problem set, and note from its real courses online for anyone, the same material students pay $60,000 a year in tuition to access. Go to ocw.mit.edu. Search any subject.

Documentary news photo, 35mm, harsh flash, film grain.

slides.headline: SAVE THIS
slides.body:
You will want these when you need them. Save this post so you can find them.

Daily AI news and real skills

caption:
Swipe to see all 6. These work in your browser right now, no email, no password, no account needed. 🔖

Photopea for full Photoshop-level photo editing, IT-Tools for 60 plus developer utilities, Excalidraw for free team whiteboards, Have I Been Pwned for data breach checks, Hugging Face Spaces for no-login AI tools, MIT OpenCourseWare for full university courses from real professors.

Most people pay monthly for tools that already exist free in their browser. The shift is not which AI to buy. It is realizing how much is already out there, free and ready.

Running a business? DM us "AI" and we'll show you what this could do for yours.
